name: AVQACL++
description: A framework and benchmark for audio-visual question answering continual learning that evaluates robustness and lifelong learning across sequential tasks and domain shifts.
reputation: New (2026) benchmark aimed at continual audio-visual QA research; limited community adoption so far but relevant to continual learning and multimodal robustness studies.
notes: Designed for continual learning with sequential tasks and domain shifts — not directly comparable to static VQA benchmarks. Requires multimodal (audio+visual) models; potential dataset size/modality imbalance and domain-shift evaluation focus mean results may not generalize to standard VQA settings.
